description: This file is a C header file defining the API for D-Bus message interaction related to CCSP SNMP Agent Proxy. It contains function declarations for initializing, shutting down, retrieving, setting parameters, managing instances, and modifying entries within the system.

methods.name: Cosa_Init
methods.description: Initializes the CCSP SNMP Agent Proxy system.

methods.name: Cosa_Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the CCSP SNMP Agent Proxy system.

methods.name: Cosa_FindDestComp
methods.description: Finds the destination component and path supporting a specified namespace.

methods.name: Cosa_GetParamValues
methods.description: Retrieves parameter values from a specified component and path.

methods.name: Cosa_SetParamValuesNoCommit
methods.description: Sets parameter values without committing changes immediately.

methods.name: Cosa_SetCommit
methods.description: Commits or rolls back parameter changes.

methods.name: Cosa_GetInstanceNums
methods.description: Retrieves instance numbers for a specific object.

methods.name: Cosa_AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a specified table.

methods.name: Cosa_DelEntry
methods.description: Deletes an entry from a specified table.

methods.name: Cosa_FreeParamValues
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for parameter value structures.

methods.name: Cosa_BackgroundCommit
methods.description: Performs background commit or rollback of parameter changes.
